falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days, similarity to bottom_2022_may_luna falls below 50% and any non-bottom pattern (blowoff_top, mid_cycle_rally, or continuation_breakdown) prints at or above 70%.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The Luna-bottom analog that justifies UNKNOWN/HOLD is broken; the engine is matching a different regime, so the current call is wrong.

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 70 on any session in the next 14 days while the primary risk proxy closes at a 20-day high.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A score of 36 is not a subdued bottom; the tape is a blowoff, so both the bottom-pattern read and the HOLD signal are invalidated.

falsification_conditions.condition: The primary risk proxy closes more than 12% below the lowest close of the current pattern-match window, and implied vol (VIX or the proxy's 30-day implied vol) makes a new 30-day high, within 14 days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This is not a May-2022-style exhaustion low; capitulation is still extending, so UNKNOWN phase and HOLD are the wrong call.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
